item.title: A DB Cooper ransom bill found in 1980 sold for $134,200 at auction in 2026
item.description: A fragment of a D.B. Cooper hijacking banknote fetched an impressive $134,200 at a Dallas auction. This particular note was part of the $200,000 ransom paid to the infamous hijacker back in 1971. Interestingly, in 1980, a young boy came across a piece of this ransom money at Tena Bar, which was later confirmed as authentic by the FBI.

item.title: Florida appeals court rejects homeowners’ legal fee claim after Hurricane Ian insurance dispute
item.description: In a recent decision, a Florida appeals court determined that homeowners Susan Reed and Kent Lonngren are ineligible to collect legal fees from Citizens Property Insurance. The couple had contested repairs linked to Hurricane Ian's 2022 storm damage. The court concluded that Citizens had fulfilled its duties, even while the homeowners pursued legal action during the appraisal phase, indicating that Citizens acted in good faith throughout the claim.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Green Card jobs: Food delivery company Instacart agrees to pay $5 million penalty for discriminating against Americans
item.description: Instacart Green Card Jobs: Department of Justice said its investigation revealed that Instacart asked US workers to physically mail their applications for PER jobs while for visa holders, electronic applications were accepted. DOJ concluded that it was a discrimination against US workers and creating a burden on them.
item.dc:creator: Poulomi Ghosh

item.title: Wall Street climbs as healthcare stocks hit record, oil prices ease
item.description: Wall Street's primary indices saw an uptick, primarily driven by healthcare stocks reaching all-time highs amid falling oil prices. Investors are scrutinizing corporate earnings, with increasing worries about artificial intelligence expenditure impacting market stability. Significant advances from companies like Eli Lilly and Equifax boosted overall market performance. Nevertheless, General Motors and Steel Dynamics struggled with elevated costs and missed profit expectations.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: California’s Irvine Lake will be drained for five years as crews repair its 93-year-old dam
item.description: This month, Irvine Lake will see a significant decrease in water levels as vital dam repairs begin. The planned drawdown will facilitate crucial construction activities, enhancing the dam's structural integrity as per regulatory requirements. Water managers are closely monitoring potential winter weather effects to ensure community safety, while conversations with environmental specialists are underway to safely relocate fish and address concerns from anglers.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Fairfield Home Listed For Sale: Mowry-Housley couple asks $2.69 million; Napa Valley farm dream drives move
item.description: Tamera Mowry-Housley and Adam Housley are making waves in real estate as they list their picturesque Fairfield, California home for $2.69 million. Having acquired a quaint Napa Valley estate that requires renovations, their vision focuses on sustainable living with an orchard and vineyard to nurture their children's outdoor adventures. This shift marks a profound transformation in their family lifestyle, moving from spacious interiors to embracing more land and nature.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: 1923 Hollywood villa linked to Valentino sells for $2.5M
item.description: The Hollywood home at 6823 Iris Circle sold for $2.5 million, exceeding its asking price by $205,000. Initially bought for $1.05 million in 2016, the house underwent extensive renovations highlighting its history and charm. The property, linked to Rudolph Valentino and Pola Negri, boasts original features alongside modern updates. Located in Whitley Heights, a historic district, the neighborhood is known for its celebrity inhabitants.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: San Antonio Park Deal: City uses $10 million buy to stop 3,500 homes; plan shields Edwards Aquifer
item.description: In June 2016, San Antonio city officials approved the acquisition of 204 acres of the Classen-Steubing Ranch. This initiative aims to preserve the land essential for the Edwards Aquifer recharge zone. The planned park space balances conservation with recreational facilities like sports fields and trails. Acquisition funding primarily derives from Texas's voter-approved Edwards Aquifer protection program and city budgets.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Steve Buscemi returned to firefighting after 9/11 and backed a charity for his former colleagues
item.description: Steve Buscemi, who once served in the New York City Fire Department, stepped up to assist at Ground Zero in the wake of 9/11. This selfless act highlighted the emotional toll on first responders. He subsequently became involved with Friends of Firefighters, a nonprofit that offers crucial mental health support, not just for firefighters but also their families, ensuring privacy.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: County Weighs Land Purchase: Sarasota County rejects 126-home deal; eyes conservation buy
item.description: In a unanimous decision, Sarasota County officials have turned down a settlement allowing residential development next to the Celery Fields. Instead, they are considering acquiring the 51-acre contested land for conservation. Following a lengthy legal dispute with D.R. Horton, the county sees this move as vital for improving stormwater management and protecting local wildlife habitats. However, the details of negotiations and funding remain unresolved, leaving the property’s future in limbo.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Beverly Hills mansion once owned by Warner Bros. co-founder Harry Warner finally sells for $27.25 million
item.description: A legendary mansion in Beverly Hills, originally built for Harry Warner, has changed hands for $27.25 million after an extended listing. Initially priced at nearly $40 million in 2016, the estate received extensive upgrades while maintaining its Old Hollywood charm. Featuring a guesthouse linked to Marilyn Monroe, this property has hosted myriad celebrations.

item.title: Forgotten Victorian camera found in Oxfordshire loft sells for £18,000 for wildlife conservation
item.description: During a house clearance in Oxfordshire, a homeowner discovered a rare Victorian camera stored for nearly 30 years. The camera, made of mahogany and brass, was auctioned for £18,000 after receiving significant interest from collectors. Proceeds from the sale will be donated to wildlife conservation charities in memory of the seller's late father. The father was passionate about nature and photographed local wildlife during his lifetime.

item.title: Mary Berry’s daughter Belles Berry’s £3.95 million Blenheim Farm mansion goes under offer
item.description: Mary Berry’s daughter, Belles Berry, has received an offer for her £3.95 million Oxfordshire mansion, Blenheim Farm. Built in 2020, the property spans 10 acres and offers over 4,000 sq ft of living space. The luxury estate features a swimming pool, tennis court, two kitchens, a games room and panoramic countryside views.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: 'Enough drama': Prince Harry says he wants to reconcile with family after years of rift
item.description: Prince Harry recently opened up about the need for reconciliation with his family, sharing his personal experiences that resonate with many who struggle with familial conflicts. He conveyed his aspirations for nurturing better connections with his father, King Charles III, and brother, Prince William. Harry also reflected on the joyous moments of his children attending a British school, honoring his mother's legacy and embracing a new chapter of healing.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan
